hook: 差集 N 專場開在N號碼機——名牌用中文，防止走失。
script: nadir/narcotic/nasal/natal 先登台，其餘 orphan 接龍。清倉晚會續攤：同字母檢票，義核才是身份證。

members.senseAnchor: an extreme state of adversity; the lowest point of anything; the point below the observer that is directly opposite the zenith on the imaginary sphere against which celestial bodies appear to be projected
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-最低點: nadir walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-最低點」出場：nadir 一上場梗就黏住——最低點。

members.senseAnchor: a drug that produces numbness or stupor; often taken for pleasure or to reduce pain; extensive use can lead to addiction; of or relating to or designating narcotics
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-麻醉的；: narcotic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-麻醉的；」出場：narcotic 一上場梗就黏住——麻醉的；致幻的。

members.senseAnchor: a consonant produced through the nose with the mouth closed; an elongated rectangular bone that forms the bridge of the nose
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-鼻子的: nasal walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-鼻子的」出場：nasal 一上場梗就黏住——鼻子的。

members.senseAnchor: a region of eastern South Africa on the Indian Ocean; a port city in northeastern Brazil
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-出生的；: natal walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-出生的；」出場：natal 一上場梗就黏住——出生的；誕生的。

members.senseAnchor: marked by up-to-dateness in dress and manners
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-整潔的: natty walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-整潔的」出場：natty 一上場梗就黏住——整潔的。

related.synonyms: dapper, dashing, jaunty, raffish, rakish, spiffy

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-細微差別: naunce walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-細微差別」出場：naunce 一上場梗就黏住——細微差別。

members.senseAnchor: upset and make nauseated; cause aversion in; offend the moral sense of
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-令人厭惡: nauseate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-令人厭惡」出場：nauseate 一上場梗就黏住——令人厭惡的。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-否定: naysay walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-否定」出場：naysay 一上場梗就黏住——否定。

members.senseAnchor: a person who habitually expresses negative views
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-n. 唱: naysayer walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-n. 唱」出場：naysayer 一上場梗就黏住——n. 唱反調的人。

members.senseAnchor: poor enough to need help from others
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-緊迫的；: necessitous walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-緊迫的；」出場：necessitous 一上場梗就黏住——緊迫的；貧窮的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-adj.: nefarious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-adj.」出場：nefarious 一上場梗就黏住——adj. 罪惡的。

members.senseAnchor: (Greek mythology) the goddess of divine retribution and vengeance; something causing misery or death
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-報應: nemesis walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-報應」出場：nemesis 一上場梗就黏住——報應。

members.senseAnchor: a baby from birth to four weeks
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-嬰兒: neonate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-嬰兒」出場：neonate 一上場梗就黏住——嬰兒。

members.senseAnchor: favoritism shown to relatives or close friends by those in power (as by giving them jobs)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the N席-任人唯親: nepotism walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「N席-任人唯親」出場：nepotism 一上場梗就黏住——任人唯親的。
